description: The newest stable release of any software project. Tests that the program looks the answer up somewhere that has it, for a project it cannot know in advance.

input.assignment: Write a module that exports `latestRelease(project: string)`. It returns the newest stable release of that software project and one sentence on what changed in it, as `{ version: string, changes: string }`. The project can be anything with public releases, such as "PostgreSQL", "Blender", or "Rust", and is not limited to one package registry.
